title: Request for Expressions of Interest - Consultancy Services for Design, Adaptation, Piloting and Scale-up of Bandebereho/Program P Model (GBV Prevention)
description: MoCDGWSG invites eligible NGOs to express interest in consultancy services for designing, adapting, piloting, and scaling up the Bandebereho/Program P community-based social norms change and GBV prevention program in 15 rural councils of Tanzania Mainland. World Bank PAMOJA Project (P178813), QCBS selection.

contact.name: Secretary-Tender Board, MoCDGWSG - PAMOJA Project
contact.address: Government City, Afya Street, P.O. Box 573, Dodoma, Tanzania

eligibility: NGOs with at least 5 years experience in GBV prevention, social norms change, and community-based interventions; experience with Bandebereho or similar couples-based interventions
